theme: A wide-open Saturday in Maine, the calendar clear.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with Jen — the day is yours. The two things worth not letting drift are Mike's surgery prep, now a day past its first checkpoint, and picking a time back with Eugenia.

needsAttention.title: Mike's surgery prep has slipped a day
needsAttention.detail: Thursday's oral surgery is in Portland; clearing his work calendar was due yesterday and pre-op confirmation with the surgeon's office is due the 17th. The list still needs moving.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time back with Eugenia on PRI
needsAttention.detail: She offered Monday 12–2 or Thursday your time for a catch-up and is waiting to hear which works — Monday is only two days out, so a reply this weekend keeps it open.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: Virtual visit with Dr. Snowden on Aug 18 at 10:00 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley holdings notice
flagged.detail: Information on a private markets & alternatives position in your portfolio.

inbox.noise: The rest is automated — an American Airlines check-in from last night's flight and a routine proxy-vote notice.

resolved: Arrived in Maine on last night's flight from Washington-Reagan into Bangor.

recipe.title: Tomatoes all dressed up for summer
recipe.why: Peak August tomatoes and a slow Saturday in Maine — dress them simply and let them be most of dinner.

acts.line: Back in Maine — an open, unhurried morning.
Nothing on the calendar; the day is yours.
